lessons.title: What is the Web?
lessons.theory: The World Wide Web is a system of interconnected documents accessed via the Internet. Think of it as a giant library where every book is connected to others by hyperlinks.
lessons.example_code: Hello, Web!
lessons.try_it: Create an HTML file with your name as a heading and save it.

quiz_questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
quiz_questions.explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language — it's the standard language for creating web pages.

lessons.title: What is HTML?
lessons.theory: HTML is the backbone of every website. It provides structure and meaning to content. Think of HTML as the skeleton of a body — it gives shape but doesn't add color or movement.
lessons.try_it: Create a page with all six heading levels and a paragraph.
